text:
maria: Heads-up — overnight we had a wave of WS reconnects where client seqnum jumped by ~2M after a proxy restart. Runtime GC treated resumes as out-of-range and evicted KV cache; tenants saw token re-requests and billing spikes. Anyone seen this pattern before?

chris: saw similar in eu-west — assumed reconnect churn but the seq jump looked wrong. logs show rapid baseline replay.

joel: looked into it: proxy uses a 32-bit baseline for session seqs. After a restart it replayed old baseline leading to a huge seq_delta. Runtime GC compares delta and evicts when out-of-range.

maria: that matches the dashboard: token counts doubled on affected routes and apdex dipped due to rehydrate tails.

alice: two fixes: quick proxy-side tolerance (grace window) or require control-plane lease before runtime GC. Tradeoffs: mem vs safety.

joel: quick mitigation idea: on resume, if seq_delta > THRESHOLD and last_resume < 5m, mark session "stale-resume" and delay GC for 60s while control-plane verification completes. Pseudocode:
```
if seq_delta > 1_000_000 and now - last_resume < 300s:
  session.state = "stale-resume"
  postpone_gc(60s)
```

chris: that will avoid immediate eviction and reduce client re-requests, but increases transient memory and complicates quota accounting.

maria: let's add telemetry first: new counter `ws_seq_discontinuity.v1` and a dashboard panel (by region/route/tenant). Use it to gate rollout.

metrics-bot: 24h counts: seq_discontinuities=142, top regions: eu-west=81, us-east=45, ap-south=16. Median token spike on affected sessions = +130%.

alice: rollout plan: 1) proxy patch with conservative grace behind feature flag, 2) add telemetry + dashboard, 3) canary in eu-west 48h, 4) if stable, promote and follow with runtime GC hardening.

chris: quota tweak: make quota estimator ignore single-session token blips if `ws_seq_discontinuity` fired within last 2m for that tenant. Who owns that? @joel?

joel: I can own the estimator change. Will open two PRs: proxy grace flag + estimator ignore. Runtime GC follow-up needs design doc.

maria: I'll create dashboard ticket and panel. @alice please approve rollout. PR links once opened. :thumbsup:

alice: approve in principle. include rollback playbook (flag flip, flush stale sessions).

maria: noted. Timeline: PRs today, canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC, evaluate 48h.

chris: also add alert: if `ws_seq_discontinuity` > 50 in 10m then page eng-platform.

metrics-bot: Alert created: WS Seq Discontinuity Surge, threshold=50/10m, notify=#eng-platform-oncall.

joel: PRs opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/pulls/4823 (grace-flag) and https://git.internal/r/redwood/quota/pulls/1291 (ignore-spike). Reviews welcome.

maria: reviewing now. thanks all.

chris: ack

alice: ack
